sentences.zh: 在2001年至2002年间，在伦敦、纽约和杰弗里·爱泼斯坦在加勒比海的私人岛屿上，

sentences.en: That same year that Jeffrey Epstein dies, Andrew decides that it's time to try to rehabilitate his image.

sentences.zh: 你觉得还有什么没说出来的，现在想说的吗？

sentences.en: Because of the public outrage, both globally and especially here in the UK, Prince Andrew decided
sentences.zh: 由于全球范围内，尤其是英国国内的公众愤怒，安德鲁王子决定

sentences.en: to step away from his royal duties, essentially saying that he was no longer going to be as front and center the way the king and the princes normally are.
sentences.zh: 退出王室职责，基本上是说他不再像国王和王子们通常那样站在聚光灯下了。

sentences.en: And so that's where things stood for several years, until 2025, Virginia Dufresne commits suicide, and her memoir is released posthumously by her family members.
sentences.zh: 事情就这样持续了几年，直到2025年，弗吉尼亚·朱弗雷自杀，她的家人在她死后出版了她的回忆录。

sentences.en: And in it, it portrays Andrew's behavior in a much more detailed and damning way.
sentences.zh: 书中以更详细、更令人震惊的方式描述了安德鲁的行为。

sentences.en: King Charles, at that point, strips the prince of his title, the Duke of York, says he can't be called a prince anymore,
sentences.zh: 查尔斯国王在那时剥夺了王子的约克公爵头衔，称他不能再被称为王子，

sentences.en: and ultimately kicks the prince out of his home that he'd lived in on the property of Windsor Castle for about 20 years.
sentences.zh: 并最终将王子赶出了他在温莎城堡内住了大约20年的家。

sentences.en: Obviously, nobody wants to get kicked out of their home, but this is not exactly like he's being banished to Siberia.
sentences.zh: 显然，没人想被赶出家门，但这并不完全等同于被流放到西伯利亚。

sentences.en: No, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 不，绝对不是。

sentences.en: I mean, he was clearly embarrassed by all of the press, but he's still, at the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他显然对所有的媒体报道感到尴尬，但归根结底，他仍然是

sentences.en: eighth in line to the throne, and the consequences were mostly social consequences, not anything else.
sentences.zh: 王位第八顺位继承人，而且后果大多是社会层面的，没有其他后果。

sentences.en: And then, of course, in January, the United States releases this enormous trove of files, three million files.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，在1月份，美国公布了这批巨大的文件，共三百万份。

sentences.en: Journalists all over the world have not even finished picking through these files.
sentences.zh: 全世界的记者甚至还没来得及看完这些文件。

sentences.zh: 但很快就出现了更多关于前安德鲁王子的惊人细节。

sentences.zh: 那么，带我们了解一下到目前为止我们从这些文件中看到了什么。

sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I think that, as you said, there were a lot of details about how close the two men were and the number of times that they were together, both parties and other places.
sentences.zh: 我认为，正如你所说，有很多关于这两个人关系有多密切以及他们在一起的次数的细节，包括聚会和其他地方。

sentences.en: But I think the most damning thing was yet another photo.
sentences.zh: 但我认为最令人震惊的是又一张照片。

sentences.en: And this one was of Andrew appearing to kind of kneel over a woman who was lying on the floor.
sentences.zh: 这张照片显示安德鲁似乎跪在一个躺在地上的女人身上。

sentences.en: Her face is blacked out, so you can't see who it is.
sentences.zh: 她的脸被遮住了，所以看不出是谁。

sentences.zh: 也很难判断她是否清醒。

sentences.zh: 但那张照片确实让人们对他在年轻女性面前行为不当的愤怒感达到了顶点。

sentences.en: And it led for the first time to the king actually putting out a statement that directly commented on Andrew's behavior.
sentences.zh: 这导致国王第一次发表声明，直接评论了安德鲁的行为。

sentences.en: It expressed what the king said was profound concern at the allegations, which continue to come to light.
sentences.zh: 声明表达了国王所说的对不断曝光的指控的深切关注。

sentences.en: And very importantly, said that if he was approached by the police, that, quote, we stand ready to support them as you would expect.
sentences.zh: 非常重要的一点是，声明称如果警方联系他，引用原话，“我们随时准备提供支持，正如你们所预期的那样”。

sentences.en: It really was, I think, the first moment that the prospect of some kind of criminal punishment for Andrew seemed more possible,
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实是第一次，安德鲁面临某种刑事处罚的可能性看起来变得更大了，

sentences.en: given the fact that the king was sort of opening the door to that idea.
sentences.zh: 因为国王在某种程度上为这个想法打开了大门。

sentences.en: But do the police need the king to open the door for them to launch any kind of investigation?
sentences.zh: 但警方需要国王为他们打开大门才能展开任何调查吗？

sentences.en: Legally, no.
sentences.zh: 从法律上讲，不需要。

sentences.en: There's no question that the police can investigate and they have the power to arrest who they want to arreSt.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，警方可以进行调查，他们有权逮捕他们想逮捕的人。

sentences.en: But I think from the public relations perspective, after years in which the family seemed very much to be trying to protect Andrew,
sentences.zh: 但我认为从公共关系的角度来看，在王室多年来似乎极力保护安德鲁之后，

sentences.en: the fact that the king had promised to help the police if they came to him, that was significant.
sentences.zh: 国王承诺如果警方找上门他会提供帮助，这意义重大。

sentences.en: I don't understand, though, if police don't need a green light from the royal family to conduct a criminal investigation,
sentences.zh: 我不明白，如果警方不需要王室的绿灯就可以进行刑事调查，

sentences.zh: 为什么在此之前甚至都没有进行过调查，考虑到针对安德鲁的刑事指控已经存在多年了？

sentences.en: And if there hasn't been one, do we know why there hasn't been one?
sentences.zh: 如果还没有进行过调查，我们知道原因吗？

sentences.en: Look, I think that is one of the big questions.
sentences.zh: 看，我认为这是最大的问题之一。

sentences.en: Why haven't police in Britain, but also in the United States, why haven't they been more aggressive in looking into the allegations and ultimately taking action?
sentences.zh: 为什么英国的警察，以及美国的警察，没有更积极地调查这些指控并最终采取行动？

sentences.en: And I think part of the answer might be that despite the allegations that have been out there,
sentences.zh: 我认为部分答案可能是，尽管有这些指控，

sentences.en: the thing that has become really powerful is less the sort of raw evidence and more the publication of that evidence.
sentences.zh: 真正变得强大的东西与其说是原始证据，不如说是这些证据的公开。

sentences.en: And the pressure that has come from that on prosecutors, on the royal family,
sentences.zh: 由此给检察官和王室带来的压力，

sentences.en: has really sort of been the thing that has driven the case forward more than the actual investigations from the authorities.
sentences.zh: 实际上比当局的实际调查更能推动案件的发展。

sentences.en: And we should note that the arrest of a former prince, if not a current prince, is still a monumentally huge deal to the British public.
sentences.zh: 我们应该注意到，逮捕一位前王子（如果不是现任王子的话）对英国公众来说仍然是一件极其重大的事情。

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: I mean, you have to think about it this way.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你得这么想。

sentences.en: The last time that a sitting member of the British royal family was arrested was in 1649, almost 400 years ago.
sentences.zh: 上一次英国王室在职成员被捕是在1649年，也就是近400年前。

sentences.en: King Charles I was arrested for treason in the middle of the English Civil War at the time.
sentences.zh: 查理一世国王在英国内战期间因叛国罪被捕。

sentences.en: That is 150 years before the United States was even around.
sentences.zh: 那是在美国建国前150年。

sentences.en: That was the last time a member of the royal family was arrested.
sentences.zh: 那是最后一次有王室成员被捕。

sentences.en: And what kind of consequences does he face if convicted?
sentences.zh: 如果被定罪，他会面临什么样的后果？

sentences.en: They're pretty serious.
sentences.zh: 非常严重。

sentences.en: He hasn't been charged yet, but assuming he was charged and ultimately convicted, he could face a maximum sentence of life in prison.
sentences.zh: 他还没有被起诉，但假设他被起诉并最终定罪，他可能面临最高终身监禁的刑罚。

sentences.en: Michael, I think this is only the third arrest total associated with the Jeffrey Epstein scandal.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我认为这总共只是与杰弗里·爱泼斯坦丑闻相关的第三次逮捕。

sentences.en: There was Jeffrey Epstein.
sentences.zh: 有杰弗里·爱泼斯坦。

sentences.en: There was his longtime associate, Ghislaine Maxwell, and now obviously Andrew.
sentences.zh: 有他长期的同伙吉丝莱恩·麦克斯韦，现在显然还有安德鲁。

sentences.en: And this arrest happened in England.
sentences.zh: 而且这次逮捕发生在英国。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, in this country, the United States, the consequences that we have seen for people associated with Jeffrey Epstein who have come under suspicion
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在这个国家，即美国，我们看到的与杰弗里·爱泼斯坦有关联并受到怀疑的人所面临的后果，

sentences.en: have largely, if not entirely, fallen outside of the legal system.
sentences.zh: 在很大程度上，如果不是全部，都落在了法律体系之外。

sentences.en: Why do you think that is?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是为什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's really interesting that part of what helps to explain, I think, the arrest of former Prince Andrew is that he is one of the most high-profile people in the land.
sentences.zh: 是的，这非常有趣，我认为有助于解释前安德鲁王子被捕的部分原因是他是这个国家最受瞩目的人之一。

sentences.en: And so I think, you know, the idea that he would ultimately become one of the first people to be actually prosecuted,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，你知道，他最终成为第一批真正被起诉、

sentences.en: arrested, and potentially charged is maybe on one level not that surprising.
sentences.zh: 逮捕并可能被定罪的人之一，在某种程度上也许并不那么令人惊讶。

sentences.en: I would also say that, you know, this country has a real media culture that involves tabloids.
sentences.zh: 我还想说，你知道，这个国家有一种真正的媒体文化，涉及小报。

sentences.en: Reporters are very aggressive.
sentences.zh: 记者们非常咄咄逼人。

sentences.en: They're like a dog with a bone.
sentences.zh: 他们就像咬住骨头的狗一样。

sentences.en: When they get into the middle of a scandal, they don't let go.
sentences.zh: 一旦卷入丑闻，他们就绝不松口。

sentences.en: And I think that all of the attention on the Epstein files underscores how hungry people are for accountability in this whole case
sentences.zh: 我认为，对爱泼斯坦档案的所有关注，都凸显了人们对这起案件中问责制的渴望有多么强烈，

sentences.en: and how much that demand for accountability exceeds what the legal system has delivered in the past several years.
sentences.zh: 这种对问责的需求，远超过去几年法律体系所能提供的结果。

sentences.en: Michael Scheer, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·希尔，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Happy to have been on.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能参与节目。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times Games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像刚才那几位一样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 即可开始游玩。

sentences.en: Nick, welcome to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 尼克，欢迎来到《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: It's great to be here, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里，瑞秋。

sentences.en: So I just finished speaking with our colleague Michael Scheer about the recent arrest of Andrew,
sentences.zh: 我刚刚和我们的同事迈克尔·希尔谈论了安德鲁最近被捕的事，

sentences.en: the former Prince Andrew of England, and how this is really the first criminal consequence we have seen since, of course, the arrest of Jeffrey Epstein,
sentences.zh: 也就是英国前安德鲁王子。这是自杰弗里·爱泼斯坦被捕，

sentences.en: the conviction of his longtime associate, Ghislaine Maxwell.
sentences.zh: 以及他的长期同伙吉丝莱恩·麦克斯韦被定罪以来，我们看到的第一个真正的刑事后果。

sentences.en: And what I want to talk to you about today is I want to focus on the fallout from the most recent batch of files
sentences.zh: 今天我想和你谈谈，重点关注最近一批由司法部公布的档案所引发的连锁反应，

sentences.en: that was released by the Justice Department, in part because the consequences here seem to be coming harder and faster for people who have been implicated.
sentences.zh: 部分原因在于，对于那些被牵连的人来说，后果似乎来得越来越猛烈、越来越快。

sentences.en: And we're going to talk about why that is.
sentences.zh: 我们将讨论其中的原因。

sentences.en: But first, I just want you to explain to us what we have been seeing over the last few days and weeks.
sentences.zh: 但首先，我想请你为我们解释一下过去几天和几周里我们所看到的情况。

sentences.en: So the Epstein files has turned every person who wants to be in the entire planet into a prosecutor with subpoena power.
sentences.zh: 爱泼斯坦档案让地球上每一个想参与的人都变成了拥有传唤权的检察官。

sentences.en: We are looking into the investigations files of the federal government for this high-profile sex predator and all of his friends and all of his associates.
sentences.zh: 我们正在调查联邦政府针对这位备受瞩目的性掠夺者，以及他所有朋友和同伙的调查档案。

sentences.en: And what we've seen is that as reporters and ordinary people are digging through these files,
sentences.zh: 我们看到的是，随着记者和普通民众深入挖掘这些档案，

sentences.en: they are finding information about his friendships with other prominent, powerful, and wealthy people.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了关于他与其他显赫、有权势且富有的人之间友谊的信息。

sentences.en: And they are beginning to face consequences for their friendship with Jeffrey Epstein, who was long dead.
sentences.zh: 这些人开始因为与早已死去的杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的友谊而面临后果。

sentences.en: I have to say, every single day, it feels like there is a new law firm partner, a new CEO,
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，每一天似乎都有新的律所合伙人、新的首席执行官，

sentences.en: a new head of something who has lost their job or position because of what has come out in these files.
sentences.zh: 或者某个机构的负责人因为这些档案中披露的内容而丢掉了工作或职位。

sentences.en: The New York Times has even come out with a whole tracker, basically, to help us keep track of all of these different names.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》甚至专门制作了一个追踪器，帮助我们记录所有这些不同的名字。

sentences.en: I want to talk about some of the most notable people to lose their jobs.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈其中一些丢掉工作的重要人物。

sentences.en: Maybe we can start with Kathy Rumler, who was, up until very recently, the general counsel for Goldman Sachs.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以从凯西·鲁姆勒开始，直到最近，她还是高盛集团的总法律顾问。

sentences.en: Kathy Rumler had always maintained that she had a strictly professional relationship with Jeffrey Epstein.
sentences.zh: 凯西·鲁姆勒一直坚称她与杰弗里·爱泼斯坦之间仅保持着纯粹的职业关系。

sentences.en: She was a lawyer, and as we all know, lawyers sometimes represent unpopular or loathsome clients.
sentences.zh: 她是一名律师，众所周知，律师有时会代理一些不受欢迎或令人厌恶的客户。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: But what these emails show was that she was more than a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 但这些邮件显示，她不仅仅是他的律师。

sentences.en: She was a friend.
sentences.zh: 她是他的朋友。

sentences.en: She was a confidant.
sentences.zh: 她是他的知己。

sentences.en: She discussed her dating life with him.
sentences.zh: 她会和他讨论自己的约会生活。

sentences.en: He gave her gifts.
sentences.zh: 他会送她礼物。

sentences.en: She called him Uncle Jeffrey.
sentences.zh: 她称呼他为“杰弗里叔叔”。

sentences.en: She signed emails XO.
sentences.zh: 她在邮件末尾写上“XO”（亲吻与拥抱）。

sentences.en: And she even gave him advice on how to handle questions about his sex crimes from the paSt.
sentences.zh: 她甚至为他出谋划策，教他如何应对过去有关他性犯罪的质询。

sentences.en: And Goldman Sachs, to be clear, did not push her out of the firm.
sentences.zh: 需要明确的是，高盛集团并没有将她赶出公司。

sentences.en: Presumably, they were fine knowing that she had represented Jeffrey Epstein.
sentences.zh: 想必他们对于她曾代理过杰弗里·爱泼斯坦并不介意。

sentences.en: But this idea that this would go farther sounds like that was what was untenable, unpalatable.
sentences.zh: 但这种关系可能会进一步深化的想法，似乎才是让人无法接受、难以忍受的。

sentences.en: I think what's fascinating about this whole series of events with all these former Epstein friends is that we can never quite see inside these institutions to find out what was the breaking point.
sentences.zh: 我认为关于这些前爱泼斯坦好友的一系列事件，最引人入胜的是，我们永远无法真正看透这些机构内部，找出所谓的“临界点”究竟是什么。

sentences.en: And we know that, as you say, Goldman stood firm by her for many days, and it appeared that she was going to stick it out.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，我们知道高盛坚持支持了她很多天，看起来她似乎能挺过去。

sentences.en: And then one day she decided, I'm going to resign.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天，她决定辞职。

sentences.en: I can't handle all the scrutiny, the constant drumbeat of stories.
sentences.zh: 她说她无法承受所有的审视和持续不断的报道压力。

sentences.en: And the mechanism really is something that's hidden from us as to whose patience was worn out firSt.
sentences.zh: 至于到底是谁的耐心先被耗尽，这种机制对我们来说确实是隐藏的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And for those reasons, I actually want to talk about somebody else who's sort of similarly interesting.
sentences.zh: 出于这些原因，我其实想谈谈另一个人，他同样很有意思。

sentences.en: And that's Brad Karp, the former longtime chairman of the law firm Paul Weiss.
sentences.zh: 那就是布拉德·卡普，保罗·韦斯律师事务所长期以来的前董事长。

sentences.en: He's really interesting in part because our audience might remember that he got a lot of flack a few months back when his firm made a deal with the Trump administration
sentences.zh: 他很有意思，部分原因是我们的听众可能还记得，几个月前当他的律所与特朗普政府达成协议时，他受到了很多抨击，

sentences.en: administration that, in exchange for providing tens of millions of dollars in free legal advice,
sentences.zh: 协议内容是，通过提供数千万美元的免费法律咨询，

sentences.en: they would be perhaps taken off the target list of the law firms that the administration was going after.
sentences.zh: 他们或许就能从政府针对的律所名单中被剔除。

sentences.en: And people were furious about that.
sentences.zh: 人们对此感到愤怒。

sentences.en: There were attorneys who left the firm.
sentences.zh: 有律师因此离开了律所。

sentences.en: The firm got a ton of blowback.
sentences.zh: 律所遭到了巨大的反弹。

sentences.en: But he survived, and he did not survive what was in the Epstein files.
sentences.zh: 但他挺过来了，但他没能挺过爱泼斯坦档案带来的冲击。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It's remarkable.
sentences.zh: 这很引人注目。

sentences.en: What we saw in the Epstein files was, again, evidence of a friendly relationship with a known predator, a known sex offender.
sentences.zh: 我们在爱泼斯坦档案中再次看到了他与一名已知的掠夺者、已知的性犯罪者保持友好关系的证据。

sentences.en: We saw that he went to a fancy dinner at Epstein's house.
sentences.zh: 我们看到他去过爱泼斯坦家参加豪华晚宴。

sentences.en: We saw that he even offered some legal opinions to Epstein about Epstein's plea deal, right?
sentences.zh: 我们甚至看到他为爱泼斯坦的认罪协议提供过法律意见，对吧？

sentences.en: The plea deal that put him in jail the first time for soliciting a minor for prostitution.
sentences.zh: 就是那份让他第一次因诱导未成年人卖淫而入狱的认罪协议。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so it seems that those details, unlike this deal with Trump that many saw as capitulation to a frivolous threat, were what pushed him over the edge and out of the chairmanship.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来，与特朗普那笔被许多人视为向无理威胁妥协的交易不同，正是这些细节将他推向了深渊，导致他失去了董事长职位。

sentences.en: What do you make of these two cases, these two people, two lawyers who had given different levels of legal advice, of course,
sentences.zh: 你如何看待这两个案例？这两个人，两位律师，当然他们提供的法律建议程度不同，

sentences.en: but had also maintained a friendship with this man long after it was known that he was a sexual predator?
sentences.zh: 但在得知此人是性掠夺者很久之后，依然与他保持着友谊？

sentences.en: I think what makes these distinctive, and perhaps the reason why they could not withstand the revelations, is that it's one thing to advise a client who is a sex predator.
sentences.zh: 我认为让他们变得特殊，或许也是他们无法承受这些揭露的原因在于，为一名性掠夺者客户提供法律建议是一回事，

sentences.en: It's a separate thing to be friends with somebody.
sentences.zh: 而与某人做朋友则是另一回事。

sentences.en: You're chummy with them.
sentences.zh: 你们关系亲密。

sentences.en: You exhibit no judgment towards them at all in the friendship realm.
sentences.zh: 在友谊的范畴内，你对他完全没有表现出任何判断力。

sentences.en: Why are you friends with this guy?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要和这家伙做朋友？

sentences.en: Why are you helping him figure out how to troubleshoot his legal problems that stem from soliciting a minor for prostitution?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要帮他解决因诱导未成年人卖淫而引发的法律问题？

sentences.en: At what point, and this is just in the mind of the listener or the reader or the person,
sentences.zh: 在什么时候——这只是听众、读者或当事人的想法——

sentences.en: at what point did a bell go off in your head to say, perhaps I should not be so close to this guy?
sentences.zh: 在什么时候你脑子里会敲响警钟，说“也许我不该和这家伙走得这么近”？

sentences.en: That is what I think was so toxic for these two people in their positions of trust at these two big institutions.
sentences.zh: 我认为这正是这两个人在各自机构的信任职位上感到如此“有毒”的原因。

sentences.en: Goldman Sachs, one of the nation's leading financial institutions, and Paul Weiss, a major law firm.
sentences.zh: 高盛是全国领先的金融机构之一，保罗·韦斯是大型律师事务所。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And just to put a finer point on it, our legal system relies on the idea that everybody deserves a criminal defense.
sentences.zh: 为了更明确一点，我们的法律体系依赖于每个人都应获得刑事辩护的理念。

sentences.en: But if you're not even his attorney, this really just seems like a favor to your friend who you know is a sexual predator.
sentences.zh: 但如果你甚至不是他的律师，这看起来真的就像是在帮一个你知道是性掠夺者的朋友。

sentences.en: When you have no evidence, you have not reviewed the case files, you don't know that this guy is innocent as an attorney.
sentences.zh: 当你没有任何证据，没有审阅过案卷，作为律师你并不知道这家伙是无辜的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And if you add one more layer, part of the connection here is the relationship with Leon Black, the billionaire investor, and work that Epstein did for Leon Black.
sentences.zh: 如果再加一层，这里的关联部分是与亿万富翁投资者莱昂·布莱克的联系，以及爱泼斯坦为莱昂·布莱克所做的工作。

sentences.en: So if you're Brad Karp, a person looking at all this is wondering,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是布拉德·卡普，看着这一切的人会想，

sentences.en: are you helping this sex predator because there's money in it for your firm because of these financial and professional relationships?
sentences.zh: 你是在帮助这个性掠夺者，是因为这些金融和职业关系能为你的律所带来利益吗？

sentences.en: Which in some ways, again, it's one thing if you're a defense lawyer.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上，再说一次，如果你是辩护律师是一回事。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's another thing.
sentences.zh: 那是另一回事。

sentences.en: But this is corporate law.
sentences.zh: 但这是公司法。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: The last person I want to talk about is Casey Wasserman, who is an enormously influential figure in media and in entertainment.
sentences.zh: 我想谈的最后一个人是凯西·瓦瑟曼，他在媒体和娱乐界是一位极具影响力的人物。

sentences.en: His talent agency represents some of the biggest names in sports and music, some of the biggest performers.
sentences.zh: 他的经纪公司代理着体育和音乐界一些最大牌的名字，一些最顶尖的表演者。

sentences.en: He separately is helping to run the Olympics.
sentences.zh: 他同时还在协助运营奥运会。

sentences.en: Tell us what happened with him.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们他发生了什么事。

sentences.en: You know, I think he's in some ways the most interesting case in a way that perhaps reveals some of the fault lines around what we make of the fallout of Epstein.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为他在某种程度上是最有趣的案例，或许揭示了我们对爱泼斯坦事件后果的看法中存在的一些分歧。

sentences.en: So you might ask, so what did he do with Epstein?
sentences.zh: 你可能会问，那他和爱泼斯坦做了什么？

sentences.en: What did he do?
sentences.zh: 他做了什么？

sentences.en: The answer, as far as we can say right now, is not much.
sentences.zh: 答案是，就我们目前所知，没做什么。

sentences.en: In 2002 and 2003, two things happened.
sentences.zh: 2002年和2003年，发生了两件事。

sentences.en: In 2002, Wasserman flew on Epstein's plane as part of a humanitarian trip with Bill Clinton.
sentences.zh: 2002年，瓦瑟曼作为与比尔·克林顿进行人道主义旅行的一部分，乘坐了爱泼斯坦的飞机。

sentences.en: It appears he was part of Clinton's entourage taking a trip on Epstein's plane.
sentences.zh: 看起来他是克林顿随行人员的一部分，搭乘了爱泼斯坦的飞机。

sentences.en: And the second thing is that after that trip in 2003, he exchanged flirty emails with Glenn Maxwell, Epstein's accomplice.
sentences.zh: 第二件事是，在2003年那次旅行后，他与爱泼斯坦的同伙格伦·麦克斯韦交换了一些调情的邮件。

sentences.en: So why are these years important?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么这些年份很重要？

sentences.en: Because this is a few years before Epstein gets arrested in Palm Beach, and that was the first clear public sign of what Epstein was up to with girls and women.
sentences.zh: 因为这是爱泼斯坦在棕榈滩被捕的前几年，那是爱泼斯坦在女孩和女性问题上所作所为的第一个明确的公开信号。

sentences.en: Maxwell's role as Epstein's accomplice doesn't begin to come into focus until a few years after that.
sentences.zh: 麦克斯韦作为爱泼斯坦同伙的角色，直到那之后几年才开始变得清晰。

sentences.en: And she isn't convicted of a crime until 2021, almost two decades after she and Wasserman were emailing each other.
sentences.zh: 而且直到2021年她才被定罪，距离她和瓦瑟曼互发邮件已经过去了近二十年。

sentences.en: And yet, this month, after some details of those exchanges became public,
sentences.zh: 然而，本月，在这些交流的一些细节公开后，

sentences.en: Casey Wasserman announced that he would step down from and try to sell his own talent agency after some higher-profile clients said they would sever ties with his firm.
sentences.zh: 凯西·瓦瑟曼宣布他将辞职并试图出售自己的经纪公司，此前一些高知名度的客户表示将与他的公司断绝关系。

sentences.en: And what do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 你对此有何看法？

sentences.en: I think it shows that even people who are not accused of taking part in Epstein's crimes, or even enabling them, can now face serious,
sentences.zh: 我认为这表明，即使是那些没有被指控参与爱泼斯坦犯罪，甚至没有协助他们的人，现在也可能面临严重的、

sentences.en: life-altering consequences just for having some association with him.
sentences.zh: 改变人生的后果，仅仅是因为与他有过一些关联。

sentences.en: You know what's really interesting, Nick?
sentences.zh: 你知道什么很有趣吗，尼克？

sentences.en: You and I were both at the epicenter of The Times' Me Too coverage.
sentences.zh: 你和我当时都处于《纽约时报》“我也是”（Me Too）报道的中心。

sentences.en: We were both investigating individuals and systems and companies that allowed people to get away with predatory criminal behavior, in some cases, for years without consequence.
sentences.zh: 我们都在调查那些允许人们在某些情况下多年来毫无后果地进行掠夺性犯罪行为的个人、系统和公司。

sentences.en: I remember at some point it felt like there was a bit of a shift,
sentences.zh: 我记得在某个时刻，感觉发生了一些转变，

sentences.en: and it felt like that shift was that society was willing to mete out consequences for lesser and lesser bad behavior.
sentences.zh: 感觉那种转变是社会愿意为越来越轻微的不良行为施加后果。

sentences.en: And so, therefore, the blast radius was getting larger and larger.
sentences.zh: 因此，爆炸半径变得越来越大。

sentences.en: And with the Epstein files and the release of them, it feels like we are getting some inkling that that might be happening on an accelerated time frame.
sentences.zh: 随着爱泼斯坦档案的发布，感觉我们似乎得到了一些暗示，这种情况可能会在加速的时间框架内发生。

sentences.en: I've spent months now thinking about and reporting on the network of power that allowed Jeffrey Epstein to operate.
sentences.zh: 我已经花了几个月的时间思考并报道允许杰弗里·爱泼斯坦运作的权力网络。

sentences.en: It was vaSt.
sentences.zh: 它是巨大的。

sentences.en: Many men and women were culpable.
sentences.zh: 许多男人和女人都有罪。

sentences.en: But the case of Casey Wasserman focuses us on this question.
sentences.zh: 但凯西·瓦瑟曼的案例让我们聚焦于这个问题。

sentences.en: How do we decide when somebody is part of that system of power?
sentences.zh: 我们如何决定某人何时属于那个权力系统？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Is it anyone who had dinner with him after his first arrest?
sentences.zh: 是任何在他第一次被捕后与他共进晚餐的人吗？

sentences.en: Is it anybody who ever met him ever?
sentences.zh: 是任何曾经见过他的人吗？

sentences.en: How about someone who spent time with him before the public even knew about his crimes?
sentences.zh: 那么在公众甚至不知道他的罪行之前就和他在一起的人呢？

sentences.en: These are the questions that we're all trying to assess.
sentences.zh: 这些是我们都在试图评估的问题。

sentences.en: Michael Scheer made the point to us earlier that people's hunger for accountability far outstrips what they feel they are getting from the legal system.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·希尔早些时候向我们指出，人们对问责制的渴望远远超过了他们从法律体系中感受到的结果。

sentences.en: Former Prince Andrew, for instance.
sentences.zh: 比如前安德鲁王子。

sentences.en: That's only, I think, the third arrest that we have seen related to Jeffrey Epstein.
sentences.zh: 我认为那只是我们看到的与杰弗里·爱泼斯坦相关的第三次逮捕。

sentences.en: Besides Jeffrey Epstein himself, of course, and Ghislaine Maxwell.
sentences.zh: 当然，除了杰弗里·爱泼斯坦本人和吉丝莱恩·麦克斯韦之外。

sentences.en: And I wonder if that helps to explain at all the public appetite for some kind of consequence like what we are seeing now,
sentences.zh: 我想知道这是否有助于解释公众对某种后果的渴望，就像我们现在看到的那样，

sentences.en: a little bit regardless of what the people have actually done.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，无论这些人实际上做了什么。

sentences.en: Look, there's a vacuum at the heart of this whole affair, which is that the principal person responsible for all of it has been dead for almost seven years.
sentences.zh: 看，整件事的核心存在一个真空，那就是所有这一切的主要责任人已经死了快七年了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's gone.
sentences.zh: 他走了。

sentences.en: He can't explain anything.
sentences.zh: 他无法解释任何事情。

sentences.en: He can't connect any dots.
sentences.zh: 他无法将任何线索串联起来。

sentences.en: He can't be tried.
sentences.zh: 他无法接受审判。

sentences.en: We cannot put him through the system of justice that we normally have to deal with this kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 我们无法让他走上我们通常处理此类事件的司法程序。

sentences.en: And what we're left with is a scandal that is like light arriving from a distant star years after the fact,
sentences.zh: 我们最终面对的是一场丑闻，就像来自遥远恒星的光，在事发多年后才抵达，

sentences.en: the afterimages of his life and his network and his connections in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 那是他过去的生活、人脉和关系留下的残影。

sentences.en: And a lot of the people who are implicated in some way in his system of power and abuse did not do anything illegal.
sentences.zh: 许多以某种方式卷入他权力和虐待体系的人，并没有做任何违法的事。

sentences.en: Or if they arguably did, some of those people might have been hard to prosecute.
sentences.zh: 或者即便他们可以说做了，其中一些人也很难被起诉。

sentences.en: But that's similar to me, too, we should point out, right?
sentences.zh: 但我们应该指出，这和我自己的情况也很像，对吧？

sentences.en: A lot of the people who lost their positions were never indicted on any kind of criminal behavior.
sentences.zh: 许多失去职位的人从未因任何犯罪行为被起诉。

sentences.en: So in some ways, it actually feels quite similar.
sentences.zh: 所以从某些方面来看，这确实感觉非常相似。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, I want to I want to separate here clearly, like when I'm reading these files, I see lots of evidence of Epstein's crimes, his trafficking over the years.
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，我想在这里做一个明确的区分，比如当我阅读这些文件时，我看到了爱泼斯坦犯罪及其多年来从事人口贩运的大量证据。

sentences.en: But let's take this other bucket, people who were not directly involved in that, but had some social relationship with him,
sentences.zh: 但让我们看看另一类人，那些没有直接参与其中，但与他有某种社交关系的人，

sentences.en: perhaps at a time when they should have known better or might have questioned why they were associating with somebody who had been convicted of soliciting a minor.
sentences.zh: 也许是在他们本该更谨慎的时候，或者本该质疑为什么与一个因招嫖未成年人而被定罪的人交往的时候。

sentences.en: And in fact, are now admitting in many cases, I shouldn't have done that.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们现在在很多情况下也承认，我不该那样做。

sentences.en: And so they're guilty, perhaps, of what we can call a social crime.
sentences.zh: 所以他们可能犯了我们所谓的“社交罪”。

sentences.en: We don't really have any agreed on framework for that.
sentences.zh: 我们并没有就此达成任何共识框架。

sentences.en: We don't have a, in this country anymore, much of a shared moral framework, a shared understanding for what deserves shame.
sentences.zh: 在这个国家，我们不再拥有多少共同的道德框架，也没有对何为羞耻的共同理解。

sentences.en: And what we're left with, from my point of view, is a kind of tribal revenge politics where you get in trouble for this stuff if your tribe gets mad about it.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，我们最终陷入了一种部落式的复仇政治，如果你的部落对此感到愤怒，你就会因此惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: But if the other tribe is mad about it, you don't get in trouble.
sentences.zh: 但如果另一个部落对此感到愤怒，你就不会有麻烦。

sentences.en: It's interesting that you use the light metaphor because I think so much of the frustration around Epstein is the opacity, the fact that these files were so difficult to get.
sentences.zh: 你使用光的比喻很有趣，因为我认为围绕爱泼斯坦的挫败感很大程度上源于这种不透明，即这些文件获取起来如此困难。

sentences.en: It took an act of Congress to get these files released.
sentences.zh: 国会专门采取了行动才让这些文件得以公开。

sentences.en: Even after these files came out, there were a whole bunch of redactions.
sentences.zh: 即使在这些文件发布后，仍然有大量的涂黑内容。

sentences.en: And there are still so many swirling conspiracy theories about what is and is not included and what we don't know.
sentences.zh: 关于其中包含什么、不包含什么以及我们不知道什么，仍然流传着许多阴谋论。

sentences.en: I find it remarkable, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋，我觉得这很引人注目。

sentences.en: There are emails I've read that, at least outwardly, seem to be from men who are not victiMs.
sentences.zh: 我读过一些邮件，至少从表面上看，似乎来自并非受害者的男性。

sentences.en: And, of course, it's hard to know.
sentences.zh: 当然，很难确定。

sentences.en: But the redactions don't make any sense to me in a lot of cases.
sentences.zh: 但在很多情况下，这些涂黑内容对我来说毫无意义。

sentences.en: There's obviously a lot of victims' names and details that are being redacted, and that's appropriate.
sentences.zh: 显然，有很多受害者的名字和细节被涂黑了，这是恰当的。

sentences.en: Of course, in a lot of cases, when you keep digging, you can find a second copy of the same email without the name redacted.
sentences.zh: 当然，在很多情况下，当你深入挖掘时，可以找到同一封邮件的第二个副本，上面没有涂黑名字。

sentences.en: But, as you were saying, so much is opaque.
sentences.zh: 但是，正如你所说，太多东西是不透明的。

sentences.en: And what is perplexing for a lot of people who are reading these documents is that this Justice Department said,
sentences.zh: 让许多阅读这些文件的人感到困惑的是，司法部曾表示，

sentences.en: we found no evidence of anything that would predicate an investigation for us.
sentences.zh: 我们没有发现任何足以让我们展开调查的证据。

sentences.en: I am not a prosecutor.
sentences.zh: 我不是检察官。

sentences.en: I'm not a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 我不是律师。

sentences.en: And I can't see behind those redactions.
sentences.zh: 我无法看穿那些涂黑的部分。

sentences.en: When I read these documents, I find that puzzling and challenging.
sentences.zh: 当我阅读这些文件时，我发现这令人困惑且充满挑战。

sentences.en: And even if they are right, even if I, as a reporter, could see behind all the redactions and come to the same conclusion they did with some legal training,
sentences.zh: 即使他们是对的，即使我作为一名记者，能看穿所有涂黑内容，并凭借一些法律训练得出与他们相同的结论，

sentences.en: you begin to understand why this hunger still exists.
sentences.zh: 你也会开始明白为什么这种渴望依然存在。

sentences.en: Right, the suspicion.
sentences.zh: 没错，那种怀疑。

sentences.en: Why this mystery, this suspicion, the who else is getting away with something?
sentences.zh: 为什么会有这种谜团、这种怀疑，还有谁逍遥法外？

sentences.en: Why haven't they been punished?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们没有受到惩罚？

sentences.en: And I think, to your point earlier, it just feeds the sense that the people who did bad things are getting away with it.
sentences.zh: 我认为，回到你刚才的观点，这只会加剧一种感觉，即那些做了坏事的人正在逃脱惩罚。

sentences.en: Even as simultaneously we see these dominoes falling, as we discussed at the top of the program.
sentences.zh: 尽管正如我们在节目开头讨论的那样，我们同时看到了这些多米诺骨牌倒下。

sentences.en: I want to bring this conversation back to where it began with former Prince Andrew and his arrest on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 我想把话题带回到开头，谈谈前安德鲁王子周四被捕的事。

sentences.en: Because I wondered whether, just given everything that we've discussed, the news of that arrest, regardless of what it was for, might have struck some people as a surprise.
sentences.zh: 因为我很好奇，鉴于我们讨论的一切，那次逮捕的消息，无论是因为什么，是否会让一些人感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Just given the fact that this is a person who had not faced any kind of legal scrutiny, legal consequences for years.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为他是一个多年来没有面临任何法律审查、法律后果的人。

sentences.en: And people might have thought he never would.
sentences.zh: 人们可能认为他永远不会面临这些。

sentences.en: I think the former Prince Andrew is, in some ways, the exception that proves the rule.
sentences.zh: 我认为前安德鲁王子在某种程度上是“例外证明规则”的例子。

sentences.en: His public association with Epstein as a figure of scandal goes back to 2010.
sentences.zh: 他作为丑闻人物与爱泼斯坦的公开联系可以追溯到2010年。

sentences.en: The story of their friendship and the scandal around it has been unfolding for 16 years.
sentences.zh: 他们友谊的故事以及围绕它的丑闻已经持续了16年。

sentences.en: And he is just now coming under criminal investigation in his home country
sentences.zh: 而他直到现在才在他的祖国受到刑事调查，

sentences.en: because of an unprecedented political alignment in this country that resulted in the release of all these documents that, in turn,
sentences.zh: 这是因为这个国家出现了一种前所未有的政治一致，导致了所有这些文件的发布，进而，

sentences.en: told us about some other things he did that might be illegal in the U.K.
sentences.zh: 告诉了我们他所做的其他一些在英国可能违法的事情。

sentences.en: And the fact that it took that long for him to face, like, a criminal consequence.
sentences.zh: 他花了那么长时间才面临刑事后果，这一事实（令人震惊）。

sentences.en: Obviously, he was stripped of his title before he fell out of favor.
sentences.zh: 显然，他在失宠之前就被剥夺了头衔。

sentences.en: But the length of time before the justice system in his country caught up with him, I think helps explain the pent-up hunger and anger and frustration people have.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，在他祖国的司法系统追上他之前所花费的时间，有助于解释人们心中压抑的渴望、愤怒和挫败感。

sentences.en: And the reason why the consequences for some other figures who are perhaps less closely tied into his crimes has been severe and rapid.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么对其他一些与他罪行联系不那么紧密的人物，惩罚却如此严厉且迅速的原因。

sentences.en: And yet, at the same time, I think it also tells us a bit about how hard it is to reach a resolution on this.
sentences.zh: 然而，与此同时，我认为这也告诉了我们，在这件事上达成解决方案有多么困难。

sentences.en: Because the man at the center of it all cannot be brought to justice.
sentences.zh: 因为处于这一切核心的那个人无法被绳之以法。

sentences.en: And there are so many questions we cannot answer right now that the survivors can't answer, that the public can't answer, that the people in charge of law and order can't answer.
sentences.zh: 现在有太多问题我们无法回答，幸存者无法回答，公众无法回答，负责法律和秩序的人也无法回答。

sentences.en: And there's almost a sense that any form of justice for anybody connected to him is important and necessary because real justice feels so elusive.
sentences.zh: 甚至有一种感觉，即对任何与他有关的人进行某种形式的审判都是重要且必要的，因为真正的正义感觉如此遥不可及。
